items.title: Sakana AI proposes QD-Rec, a quality-diversity method for recommendations
items.summary_en: Sakana AI describes QD-Rec, which pairs each recommended item with a natural-language hypothesis and uses an LLM to evolve new hypotheses from an archive of earlier ones. It was tested on M&A, customer targeting and paper recommendation, and the authors report higher average ratings than baselines in many settings.
items.source_name: Sakana AI Blog (Japanese); technical page https://pub.sakana.ai/qd-rec/
items.notes: Date from search summary of blog listing; sakana.ai unreachable. Results are authors' own claims. Blog in Japanese; English technical page exists.

items.title: Sakana Chat adds 'My Fish' memory visualization feature
items.summary_en: Sakana AI announced a feature that shows users what Sakana Chat remembers about them, when memories were used, and how they connect. Memory can be turned off in settings.

items.title: Sakana AI publishes report on Engineer Open House 2026
items.summary_en: Sakana AI posted an event report on its second engineer-focused open house. In the Q&A the company said it plans to at least double engineering headcount and to pursue large-scale pretraining.
items.notes: Date from search summary; event itself reportedly 2026-10-05. Hiring/company-plans content, not research.
